premise: Snail and Caterpillar race to Deer's hoof; they arrive at exactly the same moment, which takes all afternoon.
inspiration: The Tortoise and the Hare (Aesop), turned: two tortoises and no hare, so nobody loses, and the slowness is the fun.
lesson: Going slowly together is its own kind of winning.

en-US.title: The Slowest Race
en-US.text: {sfx:meadow} {caterpillar:face happy} [excited] Let's have a race! said {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar {caterpillar:hop}. To {deer:enter} Deer's hoof! {snail:enter} Snail {snail:pulse} agreed, and Deer {deer:pulse} stood very still to be the finish line. Ready… steady… GO! [slowly] Caterpillar went scrunch… stretch… scrunch… stretch. Snail went sliiide… sliiide. A leaf drifted down. {canvas:clouds 0.5 12s} A cloud floated by. Deer {deer:face sleeping} {deer:wobble} nearly fell asleep. By lunchtime, they were halfway. By teatime, they were nearly there. {snail:live} Snail tucked into his shell for a rest, waited, then peeked out and looked around. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Caterpillar was right beside him! [giggles] Scrunch, stretch, sliiide, and they touched Deer's hoof at the very same moment. {deer:face happy} [happily] It's a tie! said Deer. {caterpillar:hearts} {snail:hearts} {all:face happy} The best race ever, everyone agreed. Even if it did take all afternoon.

es-ES.title: La carrera más lenta
es-ES.text: {sfx:meadow} {caterpillar:face happy} [excited] ¡Vamos a hacer una carrera!, dijo {caterpillar:enter} Oruga {caterpillar:hop}. ¡Hasta la pezuña de {deer:enter} Ciervo! {snail:enter} Caracol {snail:pulse} dijo que sí, y Ciervo {deer:pulse} se quedó muy quieto para ser la meta. Preparados… listos… ¡YA! [slowly] Oruga iba encoge… estira… encoge… estira. Caracol iba desliiiza… desliiiza. Cayó una hoja. {canvas:clouds 0.5 12s} Pasó una nube. Ciervo {deer:face sleeping} {deer:wobble} casi se queda dormido. A la hora de comer, iban por la mitad. A la hora de merendar, ya casi llegaban. {snail:live} Caracol se metió en su concha a descansar, esperó, y luego asomó y miró a su alrededor. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Oruga estaba justo a su lado! [giggles] Encoge, estira, desliiiza, y tocaron la pezuña de Ciervo en el mismísimo momento. {deer:face happy} [happily] ¡Empate!, dijo Ciervo. {caterpillar:hearts} {snail:hearts} {all:face happy} La mejor carrera del mundo, dijeron todos. Aunque durara toda la tarde.

meadow.prompt: a lazy warm afternoon meadow, soft grasshoppers and a faint breeze
